rule: Rev. Proc. 2026-14 tracts in this market are eligible for nomination. They are not designated or certified 2027 QOZs.

rejected.reason: FGDL zoning is a north-Florida geography. It is not applied to SWFL parcels or cities.
EagleView republishes Lee County parcels. The public source is Lee County GIS ParcelAddress.

municipalities.name: Cape Coral
municipalities.notes: Parcels and most zoning codes in the 5–150 acre band come from the Lee County ParcelAddress layer. Cape Coral also publishes GISData/Zoning; that city layer is not spatially joined.

municipalities.name: Fort Myers
municipalities.notes: The city GIS host failed TLS certificate verification and was not ingested. City of Fort Myers rows are Lee County ParcelAddress features with MUNICODE P (tax district City of Fort Myers).

municipalities.name: Bonita Springs
municipalities.notes: No independent public parcel REST. County stub on Lee ParcelAddress.

municipalities.name: Estero
municipalities.notes: No independent public parcel REST. County stub on Lee ParcelAddress.

municipalities.name: Fort Myers Beach
municipalities.notes: No independent public parcel REST. County stub on Lee ParcelAddress.

municipalities.name: Sanibel
municipalities.notes: Parcels are on the Lee County layer. Zoning is blank there for almost every 5–150 acre Sanibel parcel. Sanibel's public REST is a future-land-use map series, not a parcel zoning code, and was not joined.

municipalities.name: Unincorporated Lee
municipalities.notes: Lee County unincorporated tax district on the same ParcelAddress layer.

municipalities.name: Naples
municipalities.notes: County ParcelJoin does not carry a city field, situs, or sales. Naples publishes a city parcel layer that republishes Collier County Property Appraiser parcels; it is not ingested a second time. City zoning is not joined.

municipalities.name: Marco Island
municipalities.notes: Named on the Collier city-limits layer. ParcelJoin has no municipality field, so these parcels are not tagged.

municipalities.name: Everglades City
municipalities.notes: Named on the Collier city-limits layer. ParcelJoin has no municipality field, so these parcels are not tagged.

municipalities.name: Sarasota
municipalities.notes: Optional SWFL county. Parcels are the existing Tampa DOH extract, shared in place. No separate city pull.

municipalities.name: Venice
municipalities.notes: Optional. Covered only by the shared Sarasota county extract.

municipalities.name: North Port
municipalities.notes: Optional. Covered only by the shared Sarasota county extract.

municipalities.name: Punta Gorda
municipalities.notes: Partial Charlotte coverage. County parcels are the DOH land-area extract. Punta Gorda zoning on Charlotte CCGISLayers is not joined.
